elementos.text: fork() copies all the memory, right?

frases: Does calling {show nov}fork copy all of a process's memory?
It seems obvious: the child is an exact {show mal}[-copy] of the parent.
But on modern systems, {strike mal}it does not.
After the fork, {show comp}parent and child [+share] the same memory pages.
The system {show pag}marks them as read-only.
When one of them {show w1}writes, a {show w2}page fault goes off.
Only then does the system {show w3}copy that page, and [+only] that one.
If nobody writes, that page is never copied.
For the exam, [+remember]: fork {show fl1}does not copy everything; {show fl2}each page is copied when someone writes to it.
lineas: copy-on-write: a page is copied when written
